records.name: Angular UAnimateOnScroll
records.purpose: Applies caller-defined classes through intersection observers.
records.surface: UAnimateOnScroll; Selector [uAnimateOnScroll]; inputs enterClass?/leaveClass?:string, root:HTMLElement|null=null, rootMargin?:string, threshold:number=0.5 with numberAttribute, once:boolean=false with booleanAttribute. Browser-guards deferred observer setup; initially hides via opacity when enterClass is given. Observer uses threshold() || 0.5, so zero becomes 0.5.
